# Obligio

> Obligio is a mobile app (iPhone and Android) that keeps a small business's licences, permits, insurance renewals and filing deadlines in one calendar with reminders. This site has a free reminder calculator, a table of US state annual report due dates taken from each state's official page with the read date, and guides. Organisational guidance, not legal or tax advice.

## Tools

- [Renewal Reminder Calculator: License and Permit Due Dates](https://obligio.com/renewal-reminder-calculator/): Enter a license, permit or filing due date to get reminder dates 30, 14, 7 and 1 days before, plus a calendar file. Free, no sign-up.

## Hubs

- [Annual Report Due Dates by State (2026 Table)](https://obligio.com/annual-report-due-dates/): When each state's annual or biennial report is due for corporations and LLCs, from each state's official page read 20 November 2026.
- [Business License and Compliance Guides for Small Business](https://obligio.com/guides/): Guides to renewing business licenses, compliance calendars and state filings, plus a free renewal reminder calculator. Sourced from official pages.

## Guides

- [ASIC Annual Review Date: Deadlines, Fees and Late Fees](https://obligio.com/asic-annual-review-date/): Your ASIC annual review date is your registration anniversary. The 28-day, 2-month and 12-month deadlines after it, 2026-27 fees and late fees.
- [Business License Renewal Tracker: Template & Rules](https://obligio.com/business-licence-renewal-tracker/): How to track business license renewals: what to record, how far ahead to set reminders, what commonly expires, and a tracker template you can copy.
- [Home-Based Business License Requirements: Checklist](https://obligio.com/compliance-checklist-for-home-based-business/): Home-based business license requirements in order: zoning, city license, seller's permit, DBA, EIN, insurance, with three city rule sets and a printable list.
- [Compliance Software for Small Business, Sorted by Job](https://obligio.com/compliance-software-for-small-business/): Compliance software for small business, sorted by job: license trackers, registered agents, payroll, SOC 2. Prices, and when a spreadsheet is enough.
- [Compliance Tracking Spreadsheet vs Tracker App](https://obligio.com/compliance-tracker-vs-spreadsheet/): A compliance tracking spreadsheet that flags due dates itself: copyable formulas, color rules, an email reminder script, and when to switch to an app.
- [Contractor License Renewal: Dates, Late Fees, Reminders](https://obligio.com/contractor-license-renewal-reminders/): Contractor license renewal in four states: cycles, board notice dates, late fees, and a reminder plan for the license, bond and insurance. Printable card.
- [How to Check if a Business License Is Valid](https://obligio.com/how-to-check-if-a-business-license-is-valid/): How to check if a business license is valid: which lookup to use, what Active, Inactive and Delinquent mean, and five checks beyond the status line.
- [How to Renew a Business License: Steps and Checklist](https://obligio.com/how-to-renew-a-business-license/): How to renew a business license: find the issuing agency, the renewal window, what to send besides the fee, and how early to start. Printable checklist.
- [License Renewal Reminder Calendar in Google Calendar](https://obligio.com/license-renewal-reminder-calendar/): Set license renewal reminders in Google Calendar: the two-event setup, its 4-week and 5-reminder limits, a dated example, and when a tracker fits better.
- [Small Business Compliance Calendar: Yearly Template & Dates](https://obligio.com/small-business-compliance-calendar/): A small business compliance calendar for the year: federal filing dates by entity type and headcount, with sources, and a yearly template to copy.
- [Business License Expired? What Happens and What to Do](https://obligio.com/what-happens-if-a-business-licence-expires/): What happens when a business license expires: late fees, work that counts as unlicensed, and the cutoff after which you must reapply, plus a fix-it plan.

## About the app

- [Obligio | Business Compliance Tracker & Renewal Reminders](https://obligio.com/): Track business licenses, insurance renewals, filing deadlines and documents with Obligio. One compliance calendar for small-business owners.
- [Obligio Privacy Policy: Account, Documents and Reports](https://obligio.com/privacy): Learn how Obligio handles account information, business records, uploaded documents and subscription data, and how to request account deletion.
- [Terms of Service](https://obligio.com/terms): Read the terms for using Obligio, the business obligation tracker, including your responsibility to verify deadlines and official requirements.
- [Support & Account Help](https://obligio.com/support): Get help with Obligio reminders, subscriptions, documents and account deletion. Contact the team for support with your business compliance tracker.
